description: Work with Gmail, Calendar, Tasks, Drive and Docs through PIHU.

tools.name: gmail_search
tools.description: Search user's real Gmail messages for a query string.

tools.name: gmail_check_unread
tools.description: Check for unread Gmail messages using real Gmail API.

tools.name: gmail_send
tools.description: Send a real email to a recipient via Gmail API.

tools.name: gmail_get_message
tools.description: Get full details and content of a specific Gmail message by ID.

tools.name: calendar_list
tools.description: List upcoming real Google Calendar events.

tools.name: calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create a new event on Google Calendar with a real Google Meet video call link.

tools.name: tasks_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks from real Google Tasks API.

tools.name: tasks_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in Google Tasks.

tools.name: docs_create
tools.description: Create a real Google Doc via Google Docs API.

tools.name: drive_search
tools.description: Search files in Google Drive.

tools.name: docs_read
tools.description: Read a Google document including its text, structure and revision ID.

tools.name: docs_append
tools.description: Append reviewed text to a document. Supply revision_id to reject concurrent edits.

tools.name: docs_replace_text
tools.description: Replace matching document text, preserving the rest of the document.

tools.name: drive_get_file
tools.description: Read Drive file metadata and its browser URL.

tools.name: drive_create_folder
tools.description: Create a Drive folder, optionally inside another folder.

tools.name: drive_upload_text
tools.description: Upload UTF-8 text or Markdown as a Drive file, optionally to a folder.

tools.name: drive_move_file
tools.description: Move a Drive file into a destination folder, removing its previous parent folders.

tools.name: drive_share_file
tools.description: Share a specific file with a user. Requires explicit confirmation; role reader/commenter/writer.

tools.name: drive_trash_file
tools.description: Move a Drive file to Trash, never permanently delete it. Requires user confirmation.

tools.name: sheets_create
tools.description: Create a Google spreadsheet and return its ID and URL.

tools.name: sheets_read
tools.description: Read cells using A1 notation, for example Sheet1!A1:D20.

tools.name: sheets_write
tools.description: Write rows of literal cell values (RAW), or append rows. Does not evaluate untrusted formulas.

tools.name: slides_create
tools.description: Create an empty Google Slides presentation.

tools.name: slides_read
tools.description: Read slides, text elements and object IDs in a presentation.

tools.name: slides_add_text_slide
tools.description: Append a title and body slide to a Google Slides presentation.

tools.name: calendar_update_event
tools.description: Update an event on the primary calendar. Times must be RFC3339 with timezone offsets.

tools.name: calendar_delete_event
tools.description: Delete a primary-calendar event after explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: tasks_update_task
tools.description: Edit or complete a Google Task in the default task list.

tools.name: tasks_delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task after explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: docs_format
tools.description: Format a document range as heading1, heading2, heading3, normal, bold or italic. Indices are Google Docs UTF-16 indices (body starts at 1).

name: google-workspace-mcp
